about: Bundled last-resort Reel scenes, one or more per theme key in scenes.THEME_KEYS (+ default). All AI-generated, no text, no real people. SDXL ones were made with the free anonymous OVHcloud AI Endpoints SDXL model; the two "approved" ones are the scenes of the 5pm CoreWeave and 8am genome Reels Javier signed off on.

scenes.prompt: a colossal glowing cyan DNA double helix hologram filling the whole upper half of the frame from edge to edge, twisting diagonally, violently glitching and fragmenting into hundreds of red and cyan shards and particles, in a vast pitch-black space, a tiny lone silhouette seen from behind far below it looking up
a long dark data center corridor of server racks with blue status lights vanishing into the distance, a lone silhouette walking away in hard backlight
a dramatic macro shot of a glowing processor chip on a circuit board, blank unmarked surface, red and blue light trails, filling the upper half of the frame

a lone man silhouette seen from behind in a pitch-dark empty interrogation room, one hard white spotlight cone from above, red and blue police lights flashing through window blinds, deep black shadows, long shadow on a bare concrete floor
the US Capitol dome at night under dramatic storm clouds and lightning, red and blue light, the dome in the upper half of the frame
a humanoid robot head and shoulders in a dark factory, hard rim light, looking at its own raised hand, in the upper half of the frame

a large vintage chrome studio microphone, brightly lit by a single warm golden spotlight, large in the upper half of the frame, a glowing golden audio waveform floating in the dark air beside it, empty dark background, no equipment, no people
